title: A folder of tests (_suite.json)
description: What a folder of the test tree answers for. `gatekit test` reads it when it walks the tree. docs/contracts/cli.md, "test".

about.description: What the tests of this folder answer for.

read.description: always (the default): read with the folder above it; named: read only when this folder is the one given to `gatekit test`.

surprises.description: Surprises of the event log allowed to every test under this folder: a kind of a blocking state (`combat_started`), or `participants` for creatures outside the cast.
